desc: The SAR 7/24 Full Size is deliberately refined, both commanding in appearance and uncompromising in performance. Its classic stainless construction and hammer-fired operation forges balance, control, and reliability with modern styling. A crisp DA/SA trigger and ergonomic body lines deliver repeatable precision and comfort. An optic-ready slide supports multiple footprints, while a flared magwell and Picatinny accessory rail further enhance speed and versatility for dependable 24/7 use.
